profile.headline: WordPress Developer • Front End Engineer • Custom Themes, ACF • Web Designer
profile.summary:
I’m a Front End Developer and WordPress specialist who builds scalable, reliable, and visually polished websites for agencies and multi-location brands. I work across custom PHP themes, ACF-driven content models, responsive UI, CSS, SCSS, Tailwind-based build systems, JavaScript, and complex WordPress environments—including multisite networks, custom navigation systems, and full template rebuilds.

I’m known for being the person who can jump into a project, make sense of what’s going on, untangle the weird bugs, and deliver clean solutions quickly. Strong communication, thoughtful problem-solving, and a calm, get-it-done mindset are core to how I work.

My current focus areas include:
• Custom WordPress + ACF theme development
• Multisite setups, location templating, and site launches
• SCSS + Tailwind (working within hybrid build systems)
• JavaScript/jQuery + Gulp workflows
• Technical SEO implementation (schema, metadata, accessibility, performance)
• Converting design files into dependable, responsive front-end builds

I came into tech after nearly 20 years in the service industry, which gave me a foundation in communication, adaptability, and customer experience—skills that genuinely set me apart as a developer.

Outside of work: I’m a dog lover, concert fanatic, interior design nerd, thrift store hunter, and home cook with big dreams of an A-frame cabin and a Herman Miller Eames lounge chair.
